CustomField.description: Set when a user clicks Pass on the Pre-Approval Follow Ups tab. Treated the same as a logged call when calculating the follow-up cadence, so the lead drops out of the queue and returns after the applicable gap (6 days within 30 days of pre-approval, 14 days from 31-60 days). Deliberately separate from call history so a Pass is never counted as an actual phone call in reporting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Last time this lead was passed on from the Pre-Approval Follow Ups queue.
CustomField.label: Pre-Approval Follow-Up Passed At
